entities.name: Orc
entities.description: Fierce, combative humanoid creature type with brutish features and often greenish skin, found on Dominaria, Tarkir and other planes.

entities.name: Ironclaw
entities.description: A refined, deviously cowardly orc lineage that fought Icatia and the Order of Leitbur and created the orgg.

entities.name: Brassclaw
entities.description: A numerous but less powerful, legendarily cowardly orc clan of Sarpadia.

entities.name: Iceclaw
entities.description: A third orc clan of Sarpadia.

entities.name: Thunder Riders
entities.description: Kathorran orc army led by Golwanda, a major warring faction of the Blood Age.

entities.name: Xandril the Executioner
entities.description: Leader of the Kor empire against the Thunder Riders.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: Vampire order that orcs of Ixalan have fought since its formation.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: Pirate organization many Ixalan orcs belong to.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: Plane to which some orcs were summoned during the Great War.

events.summary: The Kathorran orc clans unite after a drought-walk to Mornhollow and find the All-Gleam.
events.quote: Starving, they embarked on a drought-walk to Mornhollow, where they found the All-Gleam.

events.summary: The Thunder Riders clash with the Kor empire under Xandril in the Blood Age.
events.quote: they clashed with the Kor empire under Xandril the Executioner

events.summary: The Ironclaw fight the Icatian Empire using goblin kamikazes and mutations, creating the orgg.
events.quote: often using goblins as kamikazes and genetic mutations to fight the Icatian Empire

relations.quote: their enemies, Icatia and the Order of Leitbur

relations.note: Orcs of Ixalan have been enemies since its formation.
relations.quote: Orcs have been enemies of the Legion of Dusk since it was originally formed.
Many of them are members of the pirate organization known as the Brazen Coalition .
an army led by the general Golwanda
